body:
GREG, 2026-11-09 about 17:12Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #782, message 94b9e8a5), verbatim: „prosze zapisac to jako skille i instrukcje w pamieci / ja nie widze innego sensu”. He was answering the proposal (Fable, 43498a6e #781; Fable2 the same via Asistant #1183) to let coders push their own candidate commits to test branches on origin so remote runners test the exact commit, instead of multi-part mailbox bundles. It followed his question „nie rozumiem, czemu po prostu nie wysylamy brancha ?” (#780). Asistant's reading: approve that route for Engram and TermAl; record it as instructions, skills and memory under the authority-change procedure; the runner fetches the exact commit, landing unchanged, no force-push.
Status: this is his recorded word on an authority widening. It takes effect when the AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md change lands under (a) both coordinators' concurrence, (b) the exact wording sent to Greg, (c) the final-diff audit. Until then, author batches keep using bundles.
